onspawn.moveout * Dog Green at Omaha victory1 * Allied Victory! American forces have secured the Vierville Draw victory2 * Axis Victory! German forces have defended the Draw. roundstop * This round is over! playarea * Turn around usspawn1 * Get to the seawall and stage an attack on the German Bunker usspawn2 * Get to the shale and stage an attack on the German Bunker usspawn3 * Move through the draw and attack the German Bunker mgnest1 * MG Nest A mgnest2 * MG Nest B mgnest3 * MG Nest C tobruk1 * Tobruk A tobruk2 * Tobruk B bunker1 * Bunker A bunker2 * Defense Objective gunemplacement1 * Gun Emplacement A gunemplacement2 * Gun Emplacement B seawall * Rally Point shale * Rally Point germanbunker * Capture Objective vierville_draw * Vierville Draw minefield * minefield youcapon * You are capturing the bunker! alliedcapon * American forces are capturing the bunker! alliedcapoff * Axis forces have re-taken the bunker!
# new 2-stage localizations (some overlap) onspawn.1.1.1 = Get to one of the rally points and secure a beachhead! onspawn.2.1.1 = Push the American invasion force back into the sea! beachfalling = American soldiers are securing a beachhead! beachhead.1.1.1 = Rally Point beachhead.2.1.1 = Defend this area beachsecure = American forces have secured a beachhead! navalguns = American shore bombardment has ceased near the Vierville Draw! victory1 = American forces have secured a beachhead! victory2 = German forces have defeated the Allied invasion force! roundstop = This round is over. playarea = Turn around. onspawn.1.1.2 = Storm the hill and capture the Command Bunker overlooking the beach. onspawn.2.1.2 = Defend the Command Bunker from being overrun by American forces! bunkerfalling.1.1.2 = American solidiers are capturing the Command Bunker! bunkerfalling.2.1.2 = German forces have secured the Command Bunker! linebreach = American solidiers have breached the German line! germanbunker = Command Bunker beachhead = American Beachhead objective1 = American Beachhead objective2 = Command Bunker vierville_draw = Vierville Draw minefield = minefield alliedcapon = American forces are capturing the Command Bunker! alliedcapoff = Axis forces have re-captured the Command Bunker!
content.brief: The D-Day attack is several hours old and the allies are gaining ground. The German defenses are holding so far but they must defend the bunker from capture.
